newsitem.title: USA: Hostages emerge from Philadelphia standoff site.
newsitem.headline: Hostages emerge from Philadelphia standoff site.

text.p: Hostages emerged one-by-one from a check-cashing business in Philadelphia where 40-60 people were taken hostage in an apparent botched robbery attempt Friday.

Television pictures showed people, including children and a baby in a stroller, leaving the building. They were searched and questioned by police, who sought to separate hostages from any robbers who remained in the building.
The released hostages were then loaded onto a police bus. Police officials had said they would be transported to a site where they would be interviewed about the incident.
Some 40 people were released within about 30 minutes, local media reported.
Sam Little, whose wife was the 14th hostage released, told a local NBC affiliate he was "ecstatic" at her release.
